citations.narrative:
The facility is not following the program of veterinary care for sampling and testing of intestinal parasites. The program of
veterinary care prescribes fecal exams will be performed annually on 10% of canids for intestinal parasites. The facility
representative stated fecal sampling was not performed yet in 2026. The last recorded results for fecal sampling provided
by the facility were reported on 04-March-2025.
Failure to follow the parasite control program approved by the attending veterinarian may not properly protect the dogs
from parasites and may allow illness to go undetected and untreated, which may cause pain and unnecessary discomfort
to the dogs. The facility must follow the parasite control testing schedule approved by the attending veterinarian to protect
the dogs from parasites and other pests (worms, coccidia, giardia and heartworm) and have the dogs tested annually as
prescribed.
Correct by 8-September-2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.

Veterinary care for dogs. 
The facility is not following the program of veterinary care for sampling and testing of intestinal parasites. The program of 
veterinary care prescribes fecal exams will be performed annually on 10% of canids for intestinal parasites. The facility 
representative stated fecal sampling was not performed yet in 2026. The last recorded results for fecal sampling provided 
by the facility were reported on 04-March-2025.  
 
Failure to follow the parasite control program approved by the attending veterinarian may not properly protect the dogs 
from parasites and may allow illness to go undetected and untreated, which may cause pain and unnecessary discomfort 
to the dogs. The facility must follow the parasite control testing schedule approved by the attending veterinarian to protect 
the dogs from parasites and other pests (worms, coccidia, giardia and heartworm) and have the dogs tested annually as 
prescribed.  
 
Correct by 8-September-2026. 
 
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
